main_text.head: CAP. II.
De obedientia Christianorum in Domitianum sub persecutione secunda.
main_text.p: CErtum est ex Ecclesiasticis Historijs, nonnullos Christianorum, etiam sub Vespasiano & sub Tito, delicijs humani generis, aliquos Martyrium passos: sed ex libidine potiùs Præfectorum, quàm Imperatorum Elictis. Ve-rùm, ut sereno soli grandinosus imber, ita Vespasiano & Tito successit Domitia-nus,

Unde illud Tertullianus, Neronis portionem appellat. Eusebius,hæredem: & {g}Ta-citus illud ponit discrimen inter Nero-nem & Domitianum: quod Nero truculentas caedes iusserit tantum, non spectaverit Domitianus vero, & iusserit & spectaverit.{h}Vel inter initia principatus quotidie secretum sibi horarium sumere[?] solebat, nec quicquam amplius agere, quàm muscas captare, ac stylo praeacuto configere. Exinde scilicet futuræ cru-delita-

page.notes: The first word of the text is a drop cap, transcribed as "CErtum". The verse line "hyememq;" is read with some doubt on the abbreviation mark. The word after "horarium" is read as "sumere" with [?], since the first letter could be f. The notes beside the text, marked g and h, are in the right margin and are placed at the marks in the text. "Ecclesiasticis" and the words "Elictis" and "Eusebius,hæredem:" are copied as printed.
